items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I liked him now that I've heard him...you know, now, than I did then when I was recording with him.

ctx.x: Well, the records to me show he had a lot of drive.

Yeah, that's what I say. He was very good. And I liked him now that I've heard him...you know, now, than I did then when I was recording with him. I couldn't stand him then. Well, I mean, i don't want to say I couldn't stand him. It was just a date, just another date, you know. But now that I can sit back and listen to the records, and... I mean he amazes me now. His tone is beautiful on them. I mean, for an...he's what you would call an unrehearsed musician. He just picks up the clarinet and starts doing funny…
